title: Agent run request
description: The exact, frozen request handed to an AgentAdapter for one stage execution. The orchestrator writes this verbatim to stages/<stage>/request.json for provenance before invoking the adapter.

workspace_path.description: Path inside the isolated execution environment, never a host path outside the stage's own mounts.

output_schema.description: Identifier or path of the schema the adapter's structured output must satisfy, e.g. review-a.schema.json.

tools.description: The resolved tool set this stage may use, from the arm config. Recorded per request because it bounds what the reviewer could discover: a stage that can search a tree can reach conclusions one that can only open named paths cannot.

environment.description: Scoped, non-secret environment values passed into the isolated execution. Credentials are injected separately and never appear here.
